parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

If you set this parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, you must also specify the NodeId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

当配置为分片集群实例ID时，还需要配置NodeId参数
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the Mongos, shard, or ConfigServer node in the sharded cluster instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html operation to query instance ID of the Mongos, shard, or ConfigServer node.

This parameter is required if DBInstanceId is set to instance ID of a sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Mongos节点ID、Shard节点ID或ConfigServer节点ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html接口查询Mongos节点、Shard节点或ConfigServer节点的节点ID。

当DBInstanceId配置的是分片集群实例ID时，需要配置该参数
parameters.name: node_id
